subject: ddl: fix job state overridden when concurrent updates don't overlap in time range (#58495)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent focusing on DDL job state/metadata concurrency. Change introduces `model.JobW` (job + raw `job_meta` bytes), threads it through scheduler/worker, and adds an in-txn `job_meta` re-read + byte-compare in `worker.transitOneJobStep` to detect non-overlapping concurrent updates (e.g., cancel/pause/owner change) and avoid persisting stale state. Added regression test `TestCancelJobBeforeRun` to cover the race. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata/state-machine handling, or concurrency within the touched DDL/meta paths.
